tha-ap262:1.1: Aggapupphiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare / obhāsayantaṃ raṃsena Sikhinaṃ sikhinaṃ yathā. // //
tha-ap262:2.1: Aggajaṃ puppham ādāya upagacchiṃ naruttamaṃ / pasannacitto sumano Buddhassa abhiropayiṃ. // //
tha-ap262:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap262:4.1: Pañcavīsati kappamhi ahosim Amitavhayo / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap262:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Aggapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap262:10.1: Thomako-Bhikkha-Citakaṃ Campako Sattapāṭalī 'Pāhano Mañjari Paṇṇañ ca Kuṭido Aggapupphiyo gāthāyo gaṇitā c' ettha ekatālīsam-eva ca. Thomakavaggo
